If you're a small business owner and you have an iPad, you need to have these four apps downloaded to make your business run smoother. Welcome back to baddie with a Patty Season 2 episode 4. If your business is the type where you have to take any type of orders or you need to get client information before fulfilling their order, you need to have JOT form because you can create your own custom order forms or client intake forms and once your client submits the form, it'll notify you automatically and it's free. Up to five forms and I think 1,000 submissions per form. Next up, and I stress, you need a link in bio platform. It could be linktree, it could be stand store. I use linktree for baddie with a Patty and then I use stand store for my new faceless account. I just heard basically it's just gonna hold all your links, booking links, affiliate links. That way you can get paid out from the same website you don't have to send your clients a whole bunch of different links. They get one link, they can find whatever it is that they're looking for. Way easier better for your conversions. Another app that I use every single day is good notes. All of my digital planners digital notebooks live in here. And you guys already know. Good Notes has like pretty much everything you can think of, from pins, highlighters to the ability to Use stickers, images, and a whole bunch more. Last but not least, and probably the most important, is a stripe account. This is how you're gonna get paid out from your Etsy's, your stand stores, your link trees, and any other platform. Trust me, you're gonna need the stripe and a Paypal while you're at it.
